description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays a LogView inside a ScrollView, handling log output and UI updates.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView and manages its display within a ScrollView, including view inflation and text change handling.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
